name: Acid Grip

outcomes.success: The creature takes half damage and no persistent damage, and the claw moves it up to 5 feet in a direction of your choice.
outcomes.failure: The creature takes full damage and persistent damage, and the claw moves it up to 10 feet in a direction of your choice.
outcomes.criticalFailure: The creature takes double damage and full persistent damage, and the claw moves it up to 20 feet in a direction of your choice.

heightening.text: The initial damage increases by 2d8|4,6,8,10|2d8, and the persistent damage|persistent acid damage increases by 1d6|4,6,8,10|1d6.

entries: An ephemeral, taloned hand grips the target, burning it with magical acid. The target takes 2d8 acid damage plus 1d6 persistent damage|persistent acid damage depending on its Reflex save. A creature taking persistent damage from this spell takes a –10-foot status bonus to its Speeds.
